stages: CREATE: Admin defines promotion with code, budget, max_reward, wagering_multiplier (5x)
ELIGIBILITY: User must have account_status='ACTIVE', verified deposit transaction >= min_stake
ISSUE/CLAIM: claimPromotionBonus() locks promotion row (FOR UPDATE), inserts into user_bonuses
AVAILABLE: Bonus balance credited to wallets.bonus_balance
USE: Staked on bets with fundSource='bonus' or qualifying cash bets for turnover
BET/REWARD_ACTION: Qualifying bets (odds >= 1.75) advance wagering_completed via processBonusWageringProgress()
SETTLEMENT: Returns from bonus bets locked in bonus_balance (Model B) until rollover is completed
EXPIRY/RELEASE: releaseCompletedBonus() unlocks bonus upon full turnover; expireStaleBonuses() deducts expired bonuses
WALLET/LEDGER/AUDIT: Double-entry ledger journals type=CREDIT/DEBIT with append-only audit records
CREATE: Auto-grant deposit promotion configured in promotions (reward_bucket='freebet')
ELIGIBILITY: Validated on deposit CAPTURED event (new/existing eligibility, audience exclusions)
ISSUE/CLAIM: tryGrantDepositFreebet() inserts deposit_freebet_grants with status='AVAILABLE'
AVAILABLE: wallets.freebet_balance incremented with grant amount
USE: allocateCashStake() consumes freebet_balance when fundSource='freebet'
SETTLEMENT: Profit-only return on win ((odds - 1) * stake credited to cash balance; stake not returned)
VOID/CANCEL: On VOID, freebet stake is restored to freebet_balance if not expired
EXPIRY: Unused grants past expires_at marked EXPIRED
ELIGIBILITY: 1 spin per user per calendar day in Asia/Kolkata timezone
ISSUE/CLAIM: claimDailySpin() checks unique composite key (user_id, spin_date)
AVAILABLE: Awards bonus_balance, freebet_balance, or loyalty points with 24h TTL
USE: Consumed in normal wagering
EXPIRY: expireSpinGrants() sweeps unspent grants past 24 hours
ELIGIBILITY: Silver tier and above (cashbackPct > 0)
CALCULATION: Share of yesterday's net cash losses (cash stakes - cash returns) in Kolkata timezone
CLAIM: claimDailyCashback() validates UNIQUE(user_id, claim_date)
CREDIT: Credits real cash wallets.balance with double-entry ledger entry
